# GENERATED by tools/gen_capital_cities.py - do not edit by hand.
#
# The provinces below are urban in map/definition.csv. These effects hide
# that until the town is raised into a city.

# Any scope. Once per game, from on_startup.
wif_disguise_future_cities = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = wif_future_cities_disguised } }
		set_global_flag = wif_future_cities_disguised
		400 = { add_province_modifier = { static_modifiers = { wif_not_yet_a_city_plains } province = 6124 } }	# Kirov
		351 = { add_province_modifier = { static_modifiers = { wif_not_yet_a_city_forest } province = 9131 } }	# Vologda
		1085 = { add_province_modifier = { static_modifiers = { wif_not_yet_a_city_forest } province = 11170 } }	# Gayny
		397 = { add_province_modifier = { static_modifiers = { wif_not_yet_a_city_forest } province = 108 } }	# Syktyvkar
		1084 = { add_province_modifier = { static_modifiers = { wif_not_yet_a_city_forest } province = 12187 } }	# Solikamsk
	}
}

# Country scope. The capital, if it is one of the towns above and not yet
# raised, becomes the urban province the map already says it is. Also
# counts it as a city for the battalion cap (wif_city_provs).
# Does nothing for any other capital.
wif_raise_capital_city = {
	capital_scope = {
		if = {
			limit = { state = 400 NOT = { has_state_flag = wif_city_raised } }	# Kirov
			remove_province_modifier = { static_modifiers = { wif_not_yet_a_city_plains } province = 6124 }
			set_state_flag = wif_city_raised
			add_to_variable = { wif_city_provs = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { state = 351 NOT = { has_state_flag = wif_city_raised } }	# Vologda
			remove_province_modifier = { static_modifiers = { wif_not_yet_a_city_forest } province = 9131 }
			set_state_flag = wif_city_raised
			add_to_variable = { wif_city_provs = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { state = 1085 NOT = { has_state_flag = wif_city_raised } }	# Gayny
			remove_province_modifier = { static_modifiers = { wif_not_yet_a_city_forest } province = 11170 }
			set_state_flag = wif_city_raised
			add_to_variable = { wif_city_provs = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { state = 397 NOT = { has_state_flag = wif_city_raised } }	# Syktyvkar
			remove_province_modifier = { static_modifiers = { wif_not_yet_a_city_forest } province = 108 }
			set_state_flag = wif_city_raised
			add_to_variable = { wif_city_provs = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { state = 1084 NOT = { has_state_flag = wif_city_raised } }	# Solikamsk
			remove_province_modifier = { static_modifiers = { wif_not_yet_a_city_forest } province = 12187 }
			set_state_flag = wif_city_raised
			add_to_variable = { wif_city_provs = 1 }
		}
	}
	wif_recalculate_battalion_cap = yes
}
